paragraphs: Rhetorix Lab sells a video-based platform that educators use to run oral exams in their courses. Both pages describe the product as a research-informed platform for delivering asynchronous oral assessments in higher education. Question delivery and video capture run as one structured workflow rather than a video upload service.

Instructors choose Spontaneous Mode for answers given immediately or Open Mode for prepared speeches and presentations. They also define the time limits, retake policies, and preparation time for each assessment. Grading happens on the instructor's own schedule in a structured dashboard, with click-to-score rubrics, searchable transcripts, and faster playback. The platform fits LTI 1.3 compatible LMS workflows for Canvas, Blackboard, D2L, and Moodle, and grades sync automatically.

The pages address educators and instructors, and present short oral responses as a replacement for written assessments already in use. The product page names foreign language courses as a fit, citing pronunciation, prosody, and spontaneous conversation skills.

quote.text: The format changes. The goals stay the same.
